messages:
Julie (Support): Customer (org: acmeco) saying Console metrics panels just spin then show '500 Internal Server Error' or time out. Happens across multiple projects. Started ~18:20 UTC. Screenshot sent in ticket. Any ideas? :eyes:
Alex (Support): Can you paste the org id + exact steps you took? Browser console errors? Also did they hit any refresh or try incognito?
Julie (Support): org: acmeco. Steps: Console -> Projects -> Select project -> Observability -> Metrics tab -> select 1d range -> pick any panel -> click Apply. Result: spinner for ~10-15s then "500" toast. Works on small ranges (15m). Happening for at least 30m. No browser console errors other than the usual CORS preflight.
deploy-bot: deploy analytics-proxy v2.14.3 finished (1787f2a) by ci/cd at 2026-03-15T18:08:45Z
Tom (Eng - Analytics): I'm seeing elevated 504s from analytics-proxy -> analytics-es in logs around 18:20 onwards. Example from proxy logs:
```
[analytics-proxy] 2026-03-15T18:25:12Z ERROR req=7f3a upstream_timeout after 10000ms POST /api/analytics/query 504
[analytics-es] 2026-03-15T18:25:12Z WARN query_id=aa1b took 12.3s - aborted by coordinator
```
Likely long-running aggregation on daily ranges. Also notice many requests with high cardinality grouping (group by label sets).
Mona (SRE): Cluster metrics: analytics-es cpu spiking to ~92% on analytics-es-prod-0, mem okay. Heap GC pauses ~250ms. Connection queue on proxy increasing. I'm going to scale replica count from 3->5 and bump proxy upstream timeout from 10s -> 30s as a temporary mitigation.
Alex (Support): Can we give a repro curl so we can reproduce from CLI and escalate to CS if needed?
Tom (Eng - Analytics): Repro curl (redacted token):
```
curl -s -X POST 'https://console.redwood.ai/api/analytics/query' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"org_id":"acmeco","query":"{""metric"":\"request_count\",\"group_by\":[\"route\",\"status\"]}","range":{"start":"2026-03-15T00:00:00Z","end":"2026-03-15T23:59:59Z"}}'
```
Running the same payload with a 1d range times out, 15m returns quickly.
Julie (Support): Confirmed: I ran the curl with a last-15m window and the panel renders. 1d fails consistently. Customer is asking for ETA.
Mona (SRE): Scale started at 18:33 UTC. Increasing replicas and adding a small JVM GC tuning param to reduce pause. Also extended proxy timeout to 30s. Will watch. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Tom (Eng - Analytics): After scale we see error rate drop: 42% -> 3% for /api/analytics/query. Still seeing a few slow queries >10s for specific high-cardinality panels. We'll add safe-guards: limit cardinality per query and fall back to pre-aggregates.
Alex (Support): Short-term workaround for customers: reduce range to 1h/15m or use the "Compact view" toggle which hits pre-aggregated endpoint. Julie, can you share that with acmeco?
Julie (Support): Yep, I'll share and offer a quick call. Also asked if we can enable a temporary fallback route on the customer's org to metrics-legacy.
Tom (Eng - Analytics): I opened a PR to add query pagination + fallback to metrics-legacy for large-range requests (link: https://git.internal/redwood/analytics/pull/432). Will monitor perf post-merge.
Mona (SRE): Post-scale metrics: request latency p50/p95 improved and error budget stabilizing. I'll keep the replica change for 24h and then re-evaluate. Opening an incident for follow-up on shard hotness: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-1850
Julie (Support): Notified customer and offered the 15m workaround + call. They acknowledged and will test. Will mark as 'monitoring' and close when they confirm for full-day ranges. :thumbsup:
Tom (Eng - Analytics): Follow-ups: analyze query plans for top slow queries, add cardinality cap, and surface a better UX message when backend times out (instead of raw 500).
Mona (SRE): I'll check indices for hot shards and possibly re-route heavy queries to read-replicas.
Julie (Support): Thanks everyone. I'll update the ticket after customer confirms.
